title: ScadBuddy / Agent
description: The assistant's turns (cost, tokens, tool calls), its tool calls, backend calls and approvals, from the agent's traces. The agent exposes no Prometheus metrics.

list.name: DS_TEMPO
list.label: Tempo
list.description: Trace panels need a Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4); until one exists they show no data and the metric panels are unaffected.

panels.title: Turns with cost and tokens
panels.description: agent.turn spans (one per segment between parks) with what each cost: scadbuddy.cost_usd (the turn's own since #2376; older traces carry the session's running total), scadbuddy.session_cost_usd (the chat's total), tokens and tool calls. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

targets.query: {resource.service.name="scadbuddy-agent" && name="agent.turn"} | select(span.scadbuddy.outcome, span.scadbuddy.cost_usd, span.scadbuddy.input_tokens, span.scadbuddy.output_tokens, span.scadbuddy.tool_calls)

panels.title: Agent spans per second
panels.description: Spans Tempo holds per second, one series per service, so a service that stops reporting shows as a gap. Each worker reports under its Deployment's name (scadbuddy-render, scadbuddy-print, scadbuddy-projects; scadbuddy-worker before #2292). A TraceQL metrics query: it needs Tempo's metrics-generator local-blocks processor (clusters#1596, spec 2026-10-01 §7). Without it this panel is empty, which means not configured, not zero traces.

panels.title: Turns over $0.25
panels.description: Turn segments that cost more than 0.25 USD. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Resumed turns
panels.description: agent.turn.resume: a turn picking up after a human decided a parked call. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Turns that errored or parked
panels.description: Turn segments with status error, or ended parked on an approval. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Slowest tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls inside turns (agent.tool/<name>, marked by scadbuddy.tool_use_id), with the tool, its tier and outcome. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Tool calls that failed
panels.description: Tool calls with status error. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

targets.query: {resource.service.name="scadbuddy-agent" && span.scadbuddy.tool != nil && status=error} | select(span.scadbuddy.tool, span.scadbuddy.tier, span.scadbuddy.failure_class)

panels.title: Calls to the backend that failed
panels.description: The agent's openapi-fetch calls to the ScadBuddy API answered 4xx/5xx. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: MCP requests
panels.description: Requests to the agent's /mcp endpoint, by JSON-RPC method. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Approvals and how long they waited
panels.description: agent.approval: each outward call a human decided, with the decision and seconds it waited parked. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

targets.query: {resource.service.name="scadbuddy-agent" && name="agent.approval"} | select(span.scadbuddy.tool, span.scadbuddy.tier, span.scadbuddy.outcome, span.scadbuddy.wait_seconds, span.scadbuddy.decided_by_kind)

panels.title: Approvals waiting over 5 minutes
panels.description: Approvals decided after more than 300 s parked. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Warm process reuse by outcome and recycle reason
panels.description: Each turn's agent.turn.spawn span per second, by whether the session's warm Claude Code was reused (hit), started anew (miss) or replaced (recycle), and why (warm.reason: fingerprint, tail, budget, evicted). A turn with WebFetch spend or a request cut off mid-turn always recycles the next one for budget (#3597). A TraceQL metrics query: it needs Tempo's metrics-generator local-blocks processor (clusters#1596, spec 2026-10-01 §7). Without it this panel is empty, which means not configured, not zero turns.

panels.title: Warm hit ratio
panels.description: Each turn's agent.turn.spawn span by warm.outcome, stacked to 100%: the hit band is the share of turns that reused the session's warm Claude Code process (spec 2026-10-13 §5.3). A TraceQL metrics query: it needs Tempo's metrics-generator local-blocks processor (clusters#1596, spec 2026-10-01 §7). Without it this panel is empty, which means not configured, not zero turns.

panels.title: Spawn p50 and p95 by warm outcome
panels.description: How long a turn waited for its process (the agent.turn.spawn span), at the median and the 95th percentile, by warm.outcome: a hit takes a live process, a miss or a recycle starts one (spec 2026-10-13 §5.3). A TraceQL metrics query, as above.

panels.title: Releases per hour
panels.description: agent.turn.release spans per hour: turns that closed their process on a park held past park_hold_seconds (or at a shutdown, while a call was held), to go on as a parked continuation once the calls are decided (spec 2026-10-13 §5.4 "Release", agent/src/sessions/turnHost.ts). scadbuddy.parked_calls is how many calls each held. A TraceQL metrics query, as above.

panels.title: Continued turns by kind
panels.description: agent.turn spans of a placement that continues its turn, per second, by scadbuddy.continuation: parked (a released turn placed again once its calls were decided, spec 2026-10-13 §5.4) or restarted (a turn whose pod or process was lost, resumed with the restart message, §5.5). A TraceQL metrics query, as above.

panels.title: Tool activities by queue
panels.description: A turn's tool calls, each a ToolCall workflow's activity (plan 2026-10-13 Steps 9.2 and 9.3), per second, by the task queue it ran on (scadbuddy.task_queue): the shared agent-tools, or a replica's own agent-tools.<hostname> for a pinned server's calls. A TraceQL metrics query, as above.
